secret_crannog_find.text: An Ospret perches on the roof beam of the round house, watching the water below with enormous concentration.
Ospreys fish the lochs of Perthshire, and a famous pair at the Loch of the Lowes near Dunkeld have been returning for years.
It drops off the beam, circles once and lands on your arm. It seems to think you may know where the fish are.
